tabs.label: Routes
lead: GPX files you uploaded, for planning. A template holds only the structure; pick a route under “▲ Route” in the workout editor when you put it on a day (the routes you've run are listed there too).
empty: Pick a route on the left, or upload a GPX.
none_gpx: No uploaded routes yet: press “Upload GPX”
name: Route name
deleted: Deleted (workouts already on the plan keep their own copy of the route)
use_hint: To use it: in the workout editor press “▲ Route” and pick this one. In a hill-repeat workout each climb then ends with the lap button at the top and the recovery after it back at the foot, named with the climb and estimated time; the watch gets the steps and targets only, never the route.
crs_rule: Climb thresholds: average grade ≥ {g}%, climb ≥ {m} m; a drop of up to {d} m or {f}% of the climb so far (whichever is larger) doesn't end it
gen_title: Make a session from this route
gen_lead: One step per climb; press lap at the top (or where the step's name says). An easy run: runnable grades (−3 to +15%) get power, Effort Pace when pushed to COROS if you choose; steep climbs a heart-rate cap; descents no target.
gen_note: Opens the new-session dialog of the plan: check the structure chart, the steps and what the watch gets, then Save to add it to that day. It counts as a session you added; nothing scheduled is overwritten.
